Prior research recovered from data/careers/supplements.json in the existing parliament-experience checkout. Its user-supplied LinkedIn screenshot transcription (10 September 2026) is preserved as inherited evidence, not independently re-viewed in this batch. Dates require confirmation against the original profile/screenshot before headline use.
Public appointment reporting states Fujitsu commencement February 2023, whereas inherited profile transcription says January 2023; retained as unresolved conflict, not silently reconciled.

The current codebook excludes employer associations and political staff. Older supplement sector labels were recoded accordingly. Board/advisory posts are retained but not treated as full-time employment.
Public LinkedIn departure post confirms leaving Fujitsu about two years after joining but renders only a relative timestamp; no exact date inferred from it.

2026-10-01 follow-up: supplied finer hospital/Lifeline chronology, added four previously missing government advisory appointments, corroborated basketball chair appointment and2025 Fujitsu departure, and recovered first-speech source after member webpage became a placeholder. Newly retrieved profile organisation dates remain self-reported; no claim of original screenshot reinspection or full-time work.

Avenues: indexed public profile (direct999), Gippsland Water2022 primary submission, basketball institution announcement, Hansard reproduction, Bass Coast Post interview, FCA/Fujitsu appointment coverage, hospital/charity annual-report and early energy regulatory searches. No new hours, farm remuneration or historical energy-control proof. Retain January versus February2023 Fujitsu start conflict and newly identified2021 versus2022 ViPlus end discrepancy. Profile additionally lists Hawthorn young executive committee from2015, chair2015–17, with ongoing marker that needs historical cessation confirmation; future follow-up lead. Seek primary hospital/charity board appointments, Woorayl tenure, energy employer contracts/control and leave.

Second follow-up2October2026: recovered omitted Russell Broadbent electorate-officer role from2018 career interview; identified family farm as equestrian business and July2016 Harvard study as possible leave/overlap requiring investigation. Corrected Woorayl employer spelling. Canadian Ontario Energy Board counsel and US Aldred-Crouch are namesakes;2023 mid-1990s Broadbent staff quote belongs John Pesutto, not Aldred. Source2018 relative departure statement/equivalent FCA name conflicts with established appointment notices; no dates overwritten. Original Australian Carbon Innovation PDF now404. Early regulatory and hospital searches yielded no new full-time/payroll evidence. Next pursue original Broadbent staff chronology, farm remuneration/dates, Simply Energy/Green Made Easy contracts/control and Fujitsu January/February2023 discrepancy. No totals or full-time assumptions added.
